blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACT Teachers party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio on Wednesday said that he will vote to oppose the second and third readings of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill, emphasizing that there must be full transparency in the proposed amendments in next year’s budget. This is what Tinio said when asked for his vote on the second reading of the bill during the lower chamber session on Wednesday. The Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) wrapped up last week its proposed amendments to the P7.2-trillion budget bill.
